facts.text: The hotel faces the sea on the Croisette in Cannes, with views of the Palais des Festivals steps.
facts.excerpt: The iconic Majestic gazes out to sea on the Croisette in Cannes, offering up views of the Palais des Festivals’ famous steps.

facts.text: The hotel is almost one hundred years old.
facts.excerpt: At almost one hundred years of age, this five-star temple to French elegance

facts.text: The hotel's address is 10 Boulevard de La Croisette, Cannes.
facts.excerpt: 10 Boulevard de La Croisette

facts.text: The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Cannes train station.
facts.excerpt: 5 min from Cannes station

facts.text: The hotel is a few steps from the Palais des Festivals and 25 minutes from Nice airport.
facts.excerpt: Located a few steps from the Palais des Festivals and 25 minutes from Nice airport

facts.text: Ciro's Cannes, on the hotel's private beach, serves reinvented seafood cuisine with panoramic sea views.
facts.excerpt: The Majestic's beach offers reinvented seafood cuisine with panoramic sea views.

facts.text: Beefbar Cannes serves exceptional meats and fine seafood.
facts.excerpt: Beefbar Cannes: Treat yourself to a unique culinary experience by sampling exceptional meats and the finest seafood.

facts.text: La Terrasse Piscine, beside the outdoor pool, serves a sunny summer menu.
facts.excerpt: Beside the Hotel Barrière Le Majestic's outdoor pool, the Terrasse Piscine bar serves up a tasty, sunny summer menu.

facts.text: The Majestic Bar is a cocktail bar with large armchairs and beams adorned with gold leaf.
facts.excerpt: The Majestic Bar:In a sumptuous setting with large armchairs and beams adorned with gold leaves

facts.text: The outdoor pool is heated to 27 degrees Celsius all year round.
facts.excerpt: access to the outdoor heated pool at 27°C all year round

facts.text: The spa uses products from Biologique Recherche.
facts.excerpt: We use products from Biologique Recherche, renowned for its clinical approach to aesthetic care.

facts.text: The hotel has its own sauna, hammam and gym.
facts.excerpt: along with the hotel’s very own sauna, hammam and gym

facts.text: The Kid's Club offers children aged 4 to 12 activities themed on art and cinema.
facts.excerpt: give children aged 4 to 12 the opportunity to dive deep into the world of art and the silver screen

facts.text: Access to the Kid's Club for children aged 4 to 12 is included in the stay.
facts.excerpt: access to the Kid's Club for children aged 4 to 12

facts.text: The Majestic Suite has a heated infinity pool on its terrace with sea views and a butler.
facts.excerpt: Dip into the heated infinity pool that basks on the 1615 square feet terrace for a yacht club-style feel and spectacular sea views.

facts.text: The Christian Dior Suite is a Haussmann-style apartment with a terrace overlooking the sea and the red carpet, styled on the codes of the Paris fashion house.
facts.excerpt: A magnificent Haussmann-style apartment with a spacious terrace offering stunning views of the sea and the red carpet, the Christian Dior Suite

facts.text: The Escale Suite's terrace overlooks the Mediterranean and the Cannes Film Festival steps, with butler service included.
facts.excerpt: a sweeping terrace that overlooks the Mediterranean and the Cannes Film Festival’s iconic steps. Butler service included.

facts.text: Deluxe City View and Deluxe Partial Sea View rooms can be connected to the neighboring room for families.
facts.excerpt: can be connected to the neighboring room for a family-friendly stay

facts.text: Ciro's Cannes private beach is reserved for hotel guests and restaurant patrons.
facts.excerpt: Access tothe private beach of Ciro's Cannes is exclusively reserved for hotel guests and restaurant patrons.

facts.text: The private beach is open year-round except during congresses, special events and the hotel's annual closure.
facts.excerpt: Open year-round (except during congresses, special events, and the hotel's annual closure).

facts.text: Pets are allowed for a daily supplement.
facts.excerpt: Pets are allowed in the hotel with a daily supplement of 70€.

facts.text: The hotel offers water sports activities alongside its private beach and heated outdoor pool.
facts.excerpt: The private beach, heated outdoor pool and water sports activities provide the perfect setting for guests who like to get moving

facts.text: Valet parking costs extra and is priced higher from May to September.
facts.excerpt: €75 from May to September and €55 per day for the rest of the year.

facts.text: The Riviera Suite has a nautical-inspired theme and two bedrooms, each with a balcony and private marble bathroom.
facts.excerpt: With its panoramic sea views and nautical-inspired theme, the Riviera Suite is a celebration of all things Mediterranean, and features two bedrooms, each with a balcony and private marble bathroom.
